questions.stem: Which of the following is a property of metals?
questions.solution: Metals are known for their ductility, which means they can be drawn into wires. Brittleness is a property of nonmetals, and non-conductivity of heat and electricity are also properties of nonmetals. Therefore, the correct answer is ductility.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा धातुओं का गुण है?
hi.solution: धातुओं के तन्यता के गुण होते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि उन्हें तार में खींचा जा सकता है। भंगुरता अधातुओं का गुण है, और ऊष्मा और विद्युत की अचालकता भी अधातुओं के गुण हैं। अतः सही उत्तर तन्यता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate technical terms used in a Hindi-medium context.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a non-metal?
questions.solution: Sulphur is a non-metal, while copper, iron, and silver are metals. Therefore, the correct answer is sulphur.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a noble metal?
questions.solution: Gold is a noble metal because it is resistant to corrosion and oxidation. Iron and copper are more reactive and do not exhibit the same chemical stability. Silver is also a noble metal, but the question asks for one example, and gold is a well-known representative of this group.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक नोबल धातु है?
hi.solution: सोना एक नोबल धातु है क्योंकि यह जंग लगने और ऑक्सीकरण के प्रति प्रतिरोधी होता है। लोहा और तांबा अधिक क्रियाशील हैं और इनमें एक ही रासायनिक स्थिरता नहीं होती। चांदी भी एक नोबल धातु है, लेकिन प्रश्न एक उदाहरण के लिए पूछता है, और सोना इस समूह का एक ज्वलंत प्रतिनिधि है।
hi.critique: Translation accurately reflects the original meaning, technical terms are appropriate for Hindi curriculum, and the correct answer remains in the same position.

questions.stem: Which of the following metals is used to make medals?
questions.solution: Gold is a metal commonly used to make medals due to its rarity, luster, and resistance to tarnish. Iron is too brittle and reactive for such use, copper is more commonly used in wiring or alloys, and silver, while valuable, is less frequently used for medals compared to gold.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित धातुओं में से किसका उपयोग पदक बनाने के लिए किया जाता है?
hi.solution: सोना एक धातु है जिसका आम तौर पर पदक बनाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि इसकी दुर्लभता, चमक और गंध न करने की क्षमता होती है। लोहा इतना भंगुर और अभिक्रियाशील होता है कि ऐसे उपयोग के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं होता है, तांबा अक्सर तार या मिश्र धातुओं में उपयोग किया जाता है, और चांदी, यहां तक कि मूल्यवान होने के बावजूद, सोने की तुलना में पदक के लिए कम सामान्य रूप से उपयोग की जाती है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi technical terms.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for the greenish colour of the Statue of Liberty?
questions.solution: The greenish color of the Statue of Liberty is caused by a chemical reaction where copper reacts with oxygen and carbon dioxide in the air, forming copper carbonate. This process is a type of corrosion specific to copper. Other metals like iron, silver, and gold do not produce the same greenish hue when they corrode.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about noble metals?
choices: They are found in nature in the elemental state
They are never used in alloys
questions.solution: Noble metals are known for their resistance to corrosion and oxidation, which allows them to exist in nature in their pure, elemental form. This makes the statement 'They are found in nature in the elemental state' correct. The other options are incorrect because noble metals are not highly reactive, they are often used in alloys, and they are not easily oxidized.

questions.stem: Which of the following elements is a metalloid?
questions.solution: Silicon is a metalloid because it has properties between metals and nonmetals, such as partial conductivity. Sodium and iron are metals, which are good conductors and malleable, while chlorine is a nonmetal, which is typically brittle and a poor conductor. Therefore, the correct answer is silicon.
